title: Tall Whites say dominant species kill off threats

tellings.quote:
And this guy he made a real specific
point that they're not here to save the
whales. In fact, the tall whites told
him they think it's unusual that we like
ride horses and live like they said on
most of the civilized worlds to him the
spec dominant species kills off anything
that could be a threat to them.

plain: Tall, pale beings called the Tall Whites are said to have told a man that, on most civilized worlds, the dominant species kills off anything that could threaten it, and that they found it odd that humans ride horses and live alongside other animals. A guest named Kurt Metzger relays this to Michels from the account of Charles Hall, who says he met these beings at Indian Springs, Nevada, in the 1960s. Metzger stresses Hall's point that the beings are "not here to save the whales", meaning they would not be here as kindly rescuers.
